changelogs.version: v2.3.0 - Multiplatform Major Release, ATRAC9 Superframe Engine & Precision Diagnostics
items: Native Rust Sony ATRAC9 superframe decoder and hardware-accelerated Web Audio stream player for game soundtracks (snd0.at9).
Accurate decimal formatting for SDK versions (SDK 9.00, SDK 8.50, SDK 7.61) and application versions (v1.00, v1.02) without hexadecimal artifacts.
Full Windows hardening: sanitized explorer.exe path arguments, automatic read-only attribute stripping, and accurate drive metrics.
Full Linux hardening: POSIX statvfs integration for Steam Deck and UDisks2, D-Bus ShowItems file manager integration, and case-insensitive matching.
macOS innovations: real-time transfer progress dock tile badge (NSDockTile) and APFS Copy-on-Write zero-time duplication.
Multi-language NSIS installer supporting 10 languages in user-mode with optimized CI/CD compilation caching.

changelogs.version: v2.1.2 - Audio Engine & Synthesis Optimization Patch
items: Resolved zero-value exponential curve exception in WebKit AudioContext.
Transitioned to safe universal linear volume ramps for crystal-clear PS5 UI acoustics.
Immediate synchronous audio context reactivation on game card hover and selection.

changelogs.version: v2.1.1 - UI Refinement, Audio & macOS Menu
items: Fixed cover art header overlap for full-bleed 4K master cover rendering.
Calibrated WebKit/macOS AudioContext unlock with PlayStation 5 acoustic chimes on hover and selection.
Added interactive language selector in Settings with English set as default.
Streamlined top bar layout and integrated native macOS application menu items.

changelogs.version: v2.1.0 - Next-Gen Update & CDN Edge Sovereign
items: Proprietary Ultra-Low Latency Global CDN: Cloudflare R2 Edge server hosting 11,940+ vertical 4K master covers with white PS5 calqued headers, delivering artwork worldwide in <15ms.
Zero Telemetry & Absolute Anonymity Guarantee: No tracking, no IP logging, no analytics, generic browser User-Agent headers, and 100% sovereign local database.
Full Native ShadowMountPlus Ecosystem Support: Detection and deep inspection for .ffpkg (UFS), .exfat (exFAT 64KB), .ffpfs (PFS), .ffpfsc (MicroMount/MkPFS compressed containers), and folder dumps.
3D Anti-Gravity Physics Engine: Inertial spring levitation, real-time 3D tilt with 1200px perspective, and cursor-reactive volumetric elevation shadows.
Native PS5 Acoustic Architecture: Authentic harmonic sine chord for PlayStation 5 game focus and native Rust snd0.at9 decoder.
Storage Treemap Analyzer & Batch Operations: Interactive disk heat map, large backup ranking, and floating batch actions bar with keyboard shortcuts.
System Settings Panel: Full control to toggle 3D visual physics and acoustic sound effects with persistent local storage.
Rust 2021 Engine Built with opt-level=3 and LazyLock: Zero regex re-compilation overhead and maximum NVMe I/O streaming speeds.
Integrated Tauri v2 auto-updater with Minisign cryptographic signature verification.
Smooth downloading and installation of updates directly from GitHub Releases with live progress tracking.
Real-time update notifications without requiring app restart.
New Cyberpunk interface (3D Cards, Hacker Console, Holographic Disk).
Asynchronous I/O engine powered by Tokio.
Blake3 anti bit-rot integrity hashing.
Dynamic total directory space computation.
Fixed 0 GB size calculation bug on directory backups.
Added total GB summary calculation in top navigation bar.
Custom cover and title support with local database persistence.
Optimized default window dimensions for clean layout presentation.
Large SSD drive scan warning.
Official launch of Machete PS5 Backup Manager.
Automatic high-resolution vertical cover art streaming.
Relocated PPSA badge to bottom overlay.
Strict request anonymization.

changelogs.version: v2.3.0 - Major Multiplatform, ATRAC9 Audio Engine & Diagnostic Update
items: Pure Rust Sony ATRAC9 native audio decoder and Web Audio API background streaming player for official soundtracks (snd0.at9).
Exact decimal SDK version detection (SDK 9.00, SDK 8.50, SDK 7.61) and Title App version (v1.00, v1.02) with zero raw hex strings.
